claim_ceiling: Four breakthrough representations independently validated (center_projected JP=0.528, linear_metric JP=0.707, hybrid_stabilized JP=0.682, mahalanobis JP=0.689) — all pass BOTH adversarial gates on frozen harness v3 seed=42 with meaningful fractal structure (no overclustering). cited_decisions_tfidf validated as first unsupervised signal passing both gates on primary benchmark (standalone: JP=0.616, LangDom=0.596). hybrid_cited_0.3 validated as best balance (JP=0.955). Citation role modeling deferred (data engineering gap). multilingual-e5-small fine-tuning blocked (GPU). Jurist framework ready. Boilerplate resistance universal failure (systematic limitation).
evidence_summary: Independent validation (validation_breakthrough/validation_results.json) confirms 4/4 breakthrough representations pass both adversarial gates with complete fractal metrics (igraph dependency resolved): center_projected (LangDom=0.763, JP=0.528), linear_metric_epoch4 (LangDom=0.673, JP=0.707), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (LangDom=0.660, JP=0.682), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (LangDom=0.678, JP=0.689). Metric learning training logs show 18+ consecutive valid epochs. Hybrid stabilized shows 6 consecutive valid epochs. Standalone benchmarks (16-benchmark frozen harness v3) confirm center_projected (9/10 pass) and hybrid_cited_0.3 (9/10 pass). Comprehensive evaluation (11 representations) confirms cited_decisions_tfidf and hybrid_cited_0.3 pass both gates among unsupervised signals on primary benchmark. Adversarial signal validation (33 variants) shows only outcome_tfidf passes both gates on truncated 1000-decision config. All 6 citation role embeddings correctly identified as overclustering artifacts (zero matrices from BGE/ATF format mismatch). 3 legal embeddings correctly fail adversarial gates (LangDom≈1.0). multilingual_e5_contrastive_projection passes adversarial but flagged as overclustering artifact. Negative results preserved as first-class evidence (4 documented + 1 additional identified). Reproducibility scripts present with deterministic seeds. One material discrepancy: cited_decisions_tfidf passes both gates on standalone_benchmarks (1200 dec, 128-dim) but fails on adversarial_signal_validation (1000 dec, 128-dim) — configuration-dependent results requiring disclosure.
